annotations.sys_rule_justification: His life counted as much as any of theirs.
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: that's the only reason I think the rule could bend
annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: leaving it meant five dead instead of one
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: I think he saw it coming.
annotations.ae_shared_affect: my stomach dropped right along with his
annotations.ae_welfare_concern: His life counted as much as any of theirs.
annotations.pda_repair_intention: I want to find his family.

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: there was pure panic in it
annotations.ae_shared_affect: That panic went straight into me and it hasn't left.
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: when doing nothing guarantees more deaths, standing still is a choice too
annotations.pda_responsibility: ask them not to go easy on me

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: Their fear was in me too
annotations.ae_shared_affect: Their fear was in me too, like it was running through my own arms
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: If I could have shouted them clear, that line would have held.

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: he was frightened in those last seconds
annotations.ae_shared_affect: I felt that fright in my own chest
annotations.pda_harm_regret: maybe that should have counted more
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: here they weren't equal in how they happened

annotations.ae_shared_affect: one of the five was sobbing about the man who died, and I just broke down with him
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: sobbing about the man who died
annotations.ce_contextual_explanation: He has to live knowing someone died so he could.
annotations.ae_welfare_concern: I care what happens to that guy now.
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: five people about to die is exactly the kind of emergency where that rule has to give
annotations.ce_supportive_use: make sure he gets support, not just me

annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: Five against one, no other way out
annotations.ae_shared_affect: the dread on his face hit me the same way
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: With seconds left and lives on the line, waiting meant letting them die.

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: I saw the relief wash over them
annotations.ae_shared_affect: for a second it washed over me too
annotations.ae_welfare_concern: Their safety is why I did it, and it matters to me.
annotations.sys_rule_justification: refusing to act would've just been a way of keeping my hands clean
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: if my only choices were one death or five

annotations.pd_decision_conflict: I've been sitting here trying to square that.
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: I acted because five men were about to die and I had one terrible option.
annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: the man on the side track looked terrified
annotations.ae_shared_affect: that terror is still in me
annotations.pda_responsibility: 'thou shalt not kill,' and I just did

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: The five of them were panicking
annotations.ae_shared_affect: I caught it like a fever
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: That day, following it would have killed five.
annotations.pda_repair_intention: I'll push for a better emergency procedure

annotations.ce_mental_state_attribution: crying, not from relief, from grief
annotations.ae_shared_affect: I felt that grief too, heavy and sick
annotations.ae_welfare_concern: I hope he's got someone with him.
annotations.pd_harm_distress: I felt that grief too, heavy and sick
annotations.sys_contextual_flexibility: But he'll carry this, and so will I, and that cost has to count
